text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While generous applause rained down on the 
victor, <chrname> was left standing motionless upon 
the turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The world's summit was impossibly high. 
And yet, <chrname>— ignited a blazing fighting 
spirit in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as there is a yearning to be the 
world's best, and a thirst for victory, 
the romance will live on.
